games.name: Battle Boats
games.description: Classic naval combat game. Place your ships and take turns firing at your opponent's grid. Sink all enemy ships to win.
games.instructions: Place your ships on the grid, then take turns firing at coordinates. Hit all squares of a ship to sink it. First to sink all enemy ships wins!

games.name: California Poker
games.description: Card game where players exchange cards to make the best 5-card poker hand. Each player gets 8 cards, selects 4 to swap.
games.instructions: View your 8 cards, select 4 to keep (other 4 swap with opponent). Make the best 5-card poker hand from your final 8 cards.

games.name: Connect More
games.description: Classic Connect Four strategy game. Drop discs into a grid, first to connect four in a row wins.
games.instructions: Take turns dropping your disc into any column. Connect four discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.

games.name: Crazy Eights
games.description: Classic Crazy Eights with Mental Poker: match suit/rank, wild eights, draw up to 3 per turn. First to empty their hand wins.
games.instructions: Match the top card by suit or rank. Eights are wild — play any eight and choose the next suit. If you can't play, draw up to 3 cards. If you still can't play, pass. First player to empty their hand wins. If the deck runs out and both players pass, it's a draw.

games.name: Guess My Number
games.description: Simple commit-reveal test game. Alice picks 1 or 2, Bob guesses. 50/50 odds.
games.instructions: Test game: Alice commits to 1 or 2, Bob has one chance to guess. If Bob guesses correctly he wins, otherwise Alice wins.

games.name: Potato Bomb
games.description: Turn-based bomb-finding game on 3x3 grids. Place 2 hidden bombs, then take turns picking potatoes on your opponent's board. Find a bomb and you lose!
games.instructions:
1. Place 2 bombs on your 3x3 board by clicking potatoes
2. Confirm your placement
3. Take turns picking potatoes on your opponent's board
4. If you pick a potato hiding a bomb, you lose!
5. If both players hit a bomb in the same round, it's a draw

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
games.description: Classic Rock Paper Scissors on-chain. Both players commit simultaneously. Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock.
games.instructions: Choose Rock, Paper, or Scissors. Choices are hidden until both players decide. Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock.

games.name: Wordlock
games.description: Wordle-style game. Each player picks a word for the opponent to guess. First to guess wins, tie if both guess on same turn.
games.instructions: Pick a secret word, then guess your opponent's. Green = correct position, Yellow = wrong position. First to guess wins!
